hinweis: Gebäudekatalog (AT3_WIRTSCHAFT.md 10 und 6.2). Erzeugt am 18.11.2026 von tools/at3-wirtschaft.cjs aus den Tabellen des Plans, danach gepflegt im Master-Editor (Reiter „Wirtschaft“). „plan“ ist die Spalte „nimmt → gibt“ zum Nachlesen; was das Gebäude wirklich nimmt und gibt, steht in rezepte.json. „vorschlag“ nennt Angaben, die nicht im Plan stehen. Mitmach-Buden und Teilnehmer-Angebote kommen mit B18/B19. Seit N5a (20.11.2026, freigegeben von Thomas): „biom“ = Klimazonen aus „biome“ (oder „alle“), in denen das Gebäude vorkommen kann, „coast“/„river“ sind Lagen; „zweig“ = Zweig/Unterzweig aus „zweige“ für die Stadtansicht.

gebaeude.name: Cistern

gebaeude.name: Latrine
gebaeude.text: Twelve seats, no walls, great conversations.

gebaeude.name: Shrine
gebaeude.text: Leave a coin. The gods take card. Eventually.

gebaeude.name: Tavern

gebaeude.name: Temple

gebaeude.name: Forum
gebaeude.text: Free speech, paid listening.

gebaeude.name: Cemetery

gebaeude.name: Woodcutter's Hut
gebaeude.text: Trees fear him. Squirrels hate him.

gebaeude.name: Forester

gebaeude.name: Sawmill
gebaeude.text: Logs in, planks out, fingers optional.

gebaeude.name: Resin Tapper
gebaeude.text: Bleeds trees. Calls it a craft.

gebaeude.name: Carpenter

gebaeude.name: Cooper

gebaeude.name: Quarry

gebaeude.name: Stonemason

gebaeude.name: Marble Quarry

gebaeude.name: Sculptor

gebaeude.name: Lime Kiln
gebaeude.text: Burns rocks. Don't ask what else.

gebaeude.name: Sand Pit
gebaeude.text: Dig here for sand. Or for whoever owed the Lanista.

gebaeude.name: Mortar Yard

gebaeude.text: Roman concrete. Will outlive your grandchildren. And you.

gebaeude.name: Clay Pit
gebaeude.text: Mud with ambition.

gebaeude.name: Brickworks
gebaeude.text: Bakes mud until it stops complaining.

gebaeude.name: Reed Cutter
gebaeude.text: Wet feet, dry humour.

gebaeude.name: Charcoal Mound
gebaeude.text: Smokes all day. Professionally.

gebaeude.name: Peat Cutter
gebaeude.text: Sometimes he finds a fuel, sometimes a very old man.

gebaeude.name: Wheat Farm
gebaeude.text: Bread starts here, as does back pain.

gebaeude.name: Barley Farm
gebaeude.text: The noble grain of beer.

gebaeude.name: Oat Farm
gebaeude.text: Feeds horses and the poor. In that order.

gebaeude.name: Market Garden
gebaeude.text: Cabbages. The vegetable nobody throws a party for.

gebaeude.name: Vineyard
gebaeude.text: Sun, slope and slaves stomping. Two of those are fine.

gebaeude.name: Olive Grove
gebaeude.text: Trees older than the empire, and less corrupt.

gebaeude.name: Orchard
gebaeude.text: Ripe for eating, overripe for throwing.

gebaeude.name: Flax Farm
gebaeude.text: Grows bandages, eventually.

gebaeude.name: Hemp Farm
gebaeude.text: For rope. Only rope. Stop asking.

gebaeude.name: Physic Garden
gebaeude.text: Cures headaches, causes others.

gebaeude.name: Lavender Field
gebaeude.text: Makes the rich smell less like the poor.

gebaeude.name: Dye Garden
gebaeude.text: Red for the home team, blue for the corpses.

gebaeude.name: Saffron Field
gebaeude.text: Worth more than the man who picks it.

gebaeude.name: Flower Garden
gebaeude.text: Petals for winners, wreaths for the rest.

gebaeude.name: Hay Meadow
gebaeude.text: Grass, but organised.

gebaeude.name: Mushroom Shed
gebaeude.text: Dark, damp, delicious. Mostly.

gebaeude.name: Apiary
gebaeude.text: The only workers who sting back.

gebaeude.name: Sheep Farm
gebaeude.text: Count them twice. Somebody's always stealing one.

gebaeude.name: Cattle Ranch
gebaeude.text: Raised with love, sold by weight.

gebaeude.name: Pig Farm
gebaeude.text: They eat anything. We don't ask what.

gebaeude.name: Chicken Coop
gebaeude.text: The rooster fights on Sundays.

gebaeude.name: Goat Pen
gebaeude.text: Climbs everything except the social ladder.

gebaeude.name: Stud Farm
gebaeude.text: Breeds racers. Losers become sausages.

gebaeude.name: Stable
gebaeude.text: Muscle for carts, opinions not included.

gebaeude.name: Dormouse Jar Farm

gebaeude.name: Peacock Garden
gebaeude.text: Beautiful, loud, and delicious. Like a tenor.

gebaeude.name: Trapper
gebaeude.text: Patient, quiet, missing two fingers.

gebaeude.name: Fisherman's Hut
gebaeude.text: Catches fish, tells lies.

gebaeude.name: Sea Fishery

gebaeude.name: Oyster Bed

gebaeude.name: Salt Pan

gebaeude.name: Puls Kitchen

gebaeude.name: Grain Mill
gebaeude.text: Grinds grain and the occasional finger.

gebaeude.name: Bakery

gebaeude.name: Butcher

gebaeude.name: Sausage Maker

gebaeude.name: Dairy
gebaeude.text: Milk, aged until it fights back.

gebaeude.name: Ox Spit

gebaeude.name: Pie Shop
gebaeude.text: Don't look inside. Just enjoy.

gebaeude.name: Honey Bakery
gebaeude.text: Sweet enough to make a senator smile. Once.

gebaeude.name: Fish Sauce Vats

gebaeude.name: Olive Press

gebaeude.name: Malthouse

gebaeude.name: Brewery
gebaeude.text: The barbarians' only good idea.

gebaeude.name: Meadery

gebaeude.name: Winepress

gebaeude.name: Tannery

gebaeude.name: Furrier

gebaeude.name: Soap Maker

gebaeude.name: Chandler

gebaeude.name: Glassworks

gebaeude.name: Copper Mine

gebaeude.name: Tin Mine

gebaeude.name: Incense Maker

gebaeude.name: Coffin Maker

gebaeude.text: Builds ships. Some even float.

gebaeude.name: Roadside Inn
gebaeude.text: Clean sheets every month, whether you need them or not.

gebaeude.text: Swift horses, slow excuses.

gebaeude.text: Nobody likes them. Everybody pays.

gebaeude.text: Lends gold, keeps souls as collateral.

gebaeude.text: Where tradesmen agree to overcharge together.

gebaeude.text: “Mystery meat” is a promise.

gebaeude.text: Rubs out knots and memories.

gebaeude.text: Wash off the blood. Yours or theirs.

gebaeude.name: Fortune Teller
gebaeude.text: Predicts the winner. Refunds never.

gebaeude.name: Quack Doctor
gebaeude.text: Cures everything except what you have.

gebaeude.name: Saffron Spray Tower
gebaeude.text: Scented mist, so the rich can't smell the poor.

gebaeude.text: For the winner. The loser gets the sand.

gebaeude.text: Ammunition for the opinionated.

gebaeude.text: Good boys, bad intentions.
